item.zuoyanmod.jack_the_ripper_scalpel.d: §7Dagger weapon: slightly shorter reach than a sword
§7First kill grants invisibility; invisibility lasts 60s, then enters a 60s cooldown
§7Each kill while invisible adds 1 stack and does not refresh the duration
§7Each stack multiplies attack damage and attack speed by 2^stacks
§7(1 stack ×2 → 10 dmg/11.0 speed, 2 stacks ×4 → 20 dmg/22.0 speed,
§7 3 stacks ×8 → 40 dmg/44.0 speed, and so on)
§7Only works while holding the scalpel; switching weapons removes the bonus immediately
§7Cannot gain invisibility during cooldown; bonuses clear when invisibility ends or is dispelled
